channel.title: Wildcard Watch: Microsoft
channel.description: Exploited vulnerabilities and attacks involving Microsoft, each with its fix status and first step.

item.title: Patch: Multiple Vulnerabilities in Veeam Management Pack for Microsoft System Center Could Allow RCE
item.description:
Microsoft Veeam Management Pack: fix available · CCB: patch immediately

First step: Install the security update for Microsoft Veeam Management Pack. The CCB advisory lists the affected and fixed versions.

The Centre for Cybersecurity Belgium (CCB) warns about this and advises to patch immediately. The CCB advisory lists the affected versions and the fix.

High · Fix available

item.title: Patch: Microsoft Windows: Command Injection
item.description:
Microsoft Windows: RCE · pre-auth · remote · user interaction · exploited from day 0 · fix: 154.0.4258.62, 20260925.100, 10.0.14393.9612

First step: Update Microsoft Windows to the fixed version for your release line (for example 154.0.4258.62, 20260925.100 or 10.0.14393.9612).

Microsoft Windows Shell contains a command injection vulnerability that allows an unauthorized attacker to bypass a security feature over a network.

High · Fix available · CVE-2026-96951
